breakfast.name: Sausage veggie egg bake
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and grease an 8x8 baking dish.
Brown the sausage in a skillet with the olive oil for 5 minutes, breaking it up, then add the bell pepper and spinach and cook 2 minutes more.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, almond milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Spread the sausage mixture in the dish, pour the eggs over it, and sprinkle on the cheddar.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until set in the center, cool, cut into 6 squares, and refrigerate.
To serve, microwave a square per person for about 60 seconds and eat with a clementine or two.

lunch.name: Blueberry-peach smoothie
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, a squeeze of lemon, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, blueberries, peaches, almond butter, flaxseed, and cinnamon.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Unstuffed pepper skillet
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the onion and peppers 4 to 5 minutes until softened.
Add the turkey and garlic and cook 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then add the tomatoes and frozen cauliflower rice.
Simmer 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until the cauliflower is tender and most liquid is gone.
Sprinkle the mozzarella on top, cover 1 to 2 minutes to melt, and serve.

breakfast.name: Pumpkin chia pudding
steps: The night before, whisk pumpkin, almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, pumpkin pie spice, and maple syrup until smooth.
Stir in the chia seeds, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, top with the pecans, and eat cold.

dinner.name: Cajun shrimp sheet pan
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
1 red bell pepper, cut in strips
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Toss zucchini, bell pepper, and red onion with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp Cajun seasoning, and a pinch of salt and roast 10 minutes.
Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the remaining oil, Cajun seasoning, and garlic.
Add the shrimp to the pan in one layer and roast 6 to 8 minutes until pink and opaque.
Squeeze the lemon over everything and serve.

dinner.name: Chicken white bean kale soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrots, and celery 6 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, thyme, and Italian seasoning and cook 30 seconds.
Add broth and beans, bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and kale and simmer 5 minutes until the kale is tender.
Season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper, serve half topped with Parmesan, and refrigerate the other half for Saturday lunch.

dinner.name: Ginger beef and broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak or sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain
3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce or coconut aminos
steps: Whisk soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, cornstarch, and water for the sauce. Cook the cauliflower rice according to the package.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat and sear the beef in one layer 2 minutes per side, then move to a plate.
Add the broccoli and 2 tbsp water, cover, and steam-fry 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.
Add garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce, toss 1 minute until glossy, top with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve over the cauliflower rice.

dinner.name: Sesame-ginger salmon
ingredients: 2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce or coconut aminos
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic in a small bowl.
Toss bok choy and mushrooms with olive oil and a pinch of salt and spread on the pan.
Set the salmon in the middle, brush with most of the sauce, drizzle the rest over the vegetables, and roast 12 to 14 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Top with scallion and sesame seeds and serve.

breakfast.name: Pumpkin oat pancakes
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil or cooking spray
steps: Blend oats, pumpkin, cottage cheese, eggs, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and vanilla until smooth, then let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes until the edges set, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve topped with Greek yogurt, pecans, and a small drizzle of maple syrup.

lunch.name: Leftover chicken kale soup
steps: Reheat the soup in a pot over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming.
Divide between two bowls, squeeze in a little lemon, and top with Parmesan.

dinner.name: Burger wraps + sweet potato
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut in wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, toss the sweet potato wedges with 1 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and roast 25 to 30 minutes, flipping once.
Mix the beef with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
When the wedges have about 10 minutes left, heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the patties 4 minutes per side to 160 F, adding cheese in the last minute if using.
Wrap each burger in a few lettuce leaves with tomato, red onion, pickles, and Dijon.
Serve with the sweet potato wedges.

breakfast.name: Smoked salmon scramble
ingredients: 4 oz smoked salmon, torn in pieces
steps: Toast the bread and mash half the avocado on each slice with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the eggs with pepper (the salmon is salty, so go light on salt).
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, add the eggs, and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes until just set.
Fold in the smoked salmon and scallion off the heat.
Serve the eggs with the avocado toast and cherry tomatoes.

lunch.name: Tuna stuffed avocados
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz) tuna in water, drained
steps: Mix tuna, Greek yogurt, Dijon, celery, lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Scoop a little avocado out of each half to widen the hollow and stir it into the tuna.
Pile the tuna into the avocado halves and serve with cucumber slices.

dinner.name: Balsamic chicken + Brussels
ingredients: 1 lb Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Whisk balsamic, 1 tbsp olive oil, Dijon, honey, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper, and toss the chicken in half of it.
Toss Brussels sprouts and red onion with the remaining oil, salt, and pepper and spread on the pan with the chicken.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F and the sprouts are browned.
Drizzle the rest of the balsamic mixture over everything and serve.
